calls.title: What /compat does when the deploy state.json can't be read (#1208)
options: Answer cooldown and ask for no deploy until the record reads
Say it at error, then decide as if nothing were recorded, so the deploy rewrites the record
calls.why: The fresh-context review showed cooldown stalls home's deploys for good with no alert, since only the deploy writes state.json; deciding as if absent heals it, and the gauges still show a gap rather than 0.
calls.undo: Answer cooldown in deploy::decide when read_recorded is an error, and add an alert on the gap first.
